ma.showToast(Object object)

Display a toast.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
title String No Prompt content.
icon String success No Icon.
duration Number 1500 No Prompt duration.(The maximum valid value is 10000, if it exceeds 10000, it will be treated as 10000)
mask Boolean false No Whether to display a transparent mask to prevent a touch event.
image String No Local path of a customized icon. The priority of image is higher than that of icon.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
Valid Values of object.icon
Value Description
success Displays the success icon. The value of title can contain a maximum of seven Chinese characters.
error Displays the failure icon. The value of title can contain a maximum of seven Chinese characters.
loading Displays the loading icon. The value of title can contain a maximum of seven Chinese characters.
none Displays no icon. In this case, the title text can be displayed in a maximum of two lines.

Sample Code

ma.showToast({
  title: 'success',
  icon: 'success',
  duration: 2000
})
